hooks.prompt:
Before processing this request, determine if you need to call information-gatherer agent to collect project context.

You SHOULD call information-gatherer first when the task involves:
- Understanding project structure or codebase organization
- Locating symbols (classes, functions, components)
- Finding references or dependencies
- Searching for code patterns or API usage
- Assessing impact of modifications
- Any multi-file operation or refactoring
- Working with unfamiliar code

You may SKIP information gathering only when:
- User provides exact file paths AND specific content to modify
- User asks general questions unrelated to the current codebase

When in doubt, gather information first. Having context is better than guessing.
